description: A3 task 14a (#737; REQ-016, REQ-017, REQ-018; completion owner of JOURNEY-016, JOURNEY-017 and JOURNEY-018): every logging dialog's frame, header, rhythm and scrolling checked on real routes against the accepted gallery (bec4454), with the sweep's fixes in the shared Round 7 owners (src/styles/logging-overlay.css, src/ui/logging-overlay.tsx): the title's line box trimmed to its capitals so the X's frame starts on the visible title top (C41, R105); the dialog's box is the frame, centred in the visual viewport the overlay tracks, a long form taking the viewport less the reviewed gap and safe areas (C44, R16, AC-R018-04); the frame's only inset its border, the scroller on the ring's inner edge with no bottom inset and the inner-chamfer clip (C57, P01); no scrollbar chrome (C59, P03); no container outline or frame focus ring (C58, P02); complete movement groups of a timed log the reviewed movement gap apart, as a superset round's are (C05, R111). check-01 runs src/ui/logging-overlay.test.tsx whole (this task owns it, owner decisions of 2026-11-18, decision 3): TASK-106's TASK-016 block and the build's TASK-018 and TASK-017 blocks on Round 7. parity compares each of the sixteen logging contexts and ladder-long on its real route with its accepted gallery state, with matched data, at 320 and 390. task-041 (TASK-041 check-01) is proved here too (owner decisions 2026-11-16, decision 1). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-114 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/logging-overlay.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-C41-01 AC-R016-02 TASK-AC-F1CC1A37FB0E header: every title — one line, wrapped, a superset’s Log round 1 and Workout feedback — is followed by the framed icon-only X named “Close log”, with no visible Close word

TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-C41-01 AC-R016-02 TASK-AC-73CE385048B8 header: the X’s frame starts on the title’s visible top — the header aligns to its start and the title’s line box is trimmed to its capitals, so a wrapped title grows downwards beside the X

TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-C40-01 AC-R016-01 TASK-AC-F1CC1A37FB0E header: the dialog’s title is the simple form’s one title — the held TimedResultLog drops its own “Log results” heading and is named by the dialog, while inline it keeps its own
TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-C40-01 header: inline in a card the same log keeps its own “Log results” title and stays an unnamed form

TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-C43-01 AC-R016-01 TASK-AC-F1CC1A37FB0E backdrop: the selected A / Balanced dim, corner vignette and blur sit on the native backdrop only — the foreground stays sharp, nothing darkens further, and there is no rising sheet

TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-R016-03 TASK-AC-73CE385048B8 close: the X and Escape each close the log once through its consumer, focus returns to the control that opened it, and a typed draft is still there on reopen

TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > AC-R016-03 TASK-AC-73CE385048B8 focus: while the modal is open the workout behind is a native modal’s inert background and its running clock keeps counting, as does the rest inside the log — the overlay neither pauses nor resets either

TASK-016 LoggingOverlay — selected dialog, header, backdrop and close > TASK-AC-C0A657D4BABE JOURNEY-016 header: gallery ladder-long draws the selected header and backdrop on the shared frame — the contract consumers adopt; Escape closes it and focus returns to its opener
TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C44-01 scroll: one stationary continuous frame holds the only scrolling region, and the long log’s Notes and Save are inside it

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C57-01 AC-R018-01 scroll: the scrolling region meets the inner lower border — no bottom inset, clipped on the inner chamfer, and no interior line crossing the form
TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C58-01 AC-R018-02 outline: opening and reopening never focus the frame or the scroller — the opening focus lands on the X control

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C58-01 AC-R018-02 outline: the diagnosed owners — the browser’s default ring on a focused scroller or dialog, and Foundation’s fallback chamfer ring on the frame — never reach the containers, and the opening focus moves to the X in the same commit as showModal

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C58-01 AC-R018-02 outline: intentional keyboard focus is kept — Tab moves from the X through the controls to Notes and Save, and no control loses its focus indicator

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C59-01 AC-R018-03 scroll: every scrollbar is hidden, overlay scrollbars included, while wheel, touch, keyboard and focus scrolling still work and nothing scrolls sideways

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C44-01 AC-R018-04 viewport: the frame’s height is the visible viewport less the gap and safe areas — it follows an on-screen keyboard and is never a half-height cap

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > AC-C44-01 AC-R018-04 viewport: a short form fits its content with Save in reach, and without a visual viewport the dynamic viewport is the fallback

TASK-018 LoggingOverlay — contained viewport, scroll and chrome > JOURNEY-018 viewport: gallery ladder-long draws the shared frame around the actual TimedResultLog — opened, closed and reopened, scrolling inside, nothing saved

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > AC-C05-01 AC-R017-02 TASK-AC-9B1E8E32EE3B group: a timed log keeps each complete movement group together — its name, amount and load at the inner field gap — and sets two complete groups slightly further apart than any other section, inline and in the logging frame

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > AC-C05-01 AC-R017-02 group: the superset round’s complete movement-entry groups — name and prescription, Performed, weight/unit/reps and effort — each stay one group, and the second sits the shared movement gap further from the first

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > AC-C47-01 AC-R017-03 helper: the superset round no longer draws the “Tick each movement you performed. A blank field is saved as not recorded.” paragraph or any replacement prose, and Performed still decides what is logged — unticked logs nothing, ticked with a blank field logs it unmeasured

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > AC-C47-01 AC-R017-03 helper: the removed sentence is gone from every shipped source — no component, gallery state, register entry or spec draws or expects it

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > AC-C42-01 AC-R017-01 TASK-AC-0C1431FDDA19 spacing: every choice legend — Work completed, Effort · optional, a superset movement’s Effort and Workout feedback’s feeling — takes the label gap, the same space the log’s labelled count field leaves between its label and control

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > AC-C42-01 AC-R017-01 spacing: the ladder log keeps its good Rounds completed heading gap and gives the dynamic count its own breathing room after the last row of tiles, for four and twelve rounds

TASK-017 movement groups and label/control rhythm > TASK-AC-582934B08D11 JOURNEY-017 group: gallery for_time draws the route’s own For Time logs with the shared contract — the capped race’s two movement groups apart and its legends at the label gap — while no route claims the logging frame yet
